gloss: to apply; to put to practical use; to adapt

definitions.gloss: to apply; to put to practical use; to adapt
definitions.explanation: To take knowledge, theory, or techniques and use them in a new, practical context.

examples.japanese: {理論|りろん}を{実践|じっせん}に{応用|おうよう}する。
この{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{医療|いりょう}{分野|ぶんや}に{応用|おうよう}できる。
examples.english: This technology can be applied to the medical field.

examples.japanese: {基礎|きそ}を{学|まな}んだら、{次|つぎ}は{応用|おうよう}{問題|もんだい}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}しよう。
examples.english: Once you've learned the basics, try the applied problems next.

examples.japanese: AIの{応用|おうよう}{範囲|はんい}は{年々|ねんねん}{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: The range of AI applications is expanding year by year.

notes:
Paired with {基礎|きそ} (basics/fundamentals) as its complement. In education, {基礎|きそ} and {応用|おうよう} represent the progression from foundational knowledge to practical application. Also used broadly in science and technology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応用|おうよう}{問題|もんだい}: applied/advanced problem
- {応用|おうよう}{力|りょく}: ability to apply knowledge
- {応用|おうよう}{科学|かがく}: applied science
- {応用|おうよう}{範囲|はんい}: range of application
- {応用|おうよう}が{利|き}く: to be versatile, adaptable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {利用|りよう}する: to use, to utilize — more general; simply using something that is available
- {活用|かつよう}する: to make good use of — emphasizes effective, productive use
- {適用|てきよう}する: to apply (rules, laws) — specifically applying rules or standards to cases
